name: NAS-Bench-Graph
description: A benchmark providing a precomputed search space and evaluation results to systematically evaluate Graph Neural Architecture Search (GNAS) methods on graph tasks.
typical_sota_score: Varies by dataset; typically ~80–95% accuracy on common graph classification/node classification tasks
reputation: Well-regarded within the Graph Neural Architecture Search (GNAS) research community as a reproducible, precomputed NAS benchmark.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; constrained to the provided search space and precomputed evaluations—can encourage overfitting to the benchmark; task/dataset diversity is limited compared to real-world graph workloads.
